desc: Enhance your shooting precision with the Allen Company Lite Rest Tall Boy Shooting. Ideal for the range, hunting blind, or varmint shooting, this versatile shooting rest offers two adjustable heights of 4.5" and 8.5", perfect for both bench rest shooting and AR platform Modern Sporting Rifles with extended magazines. Made from durable closed-cell foam, it provides a stable and moisture-resistant shooting platform. The removable feet ensure a solid base on any surface, while the foam construction is gentle enough to rest on a truck hood without scratching. Lightweight at just 3 ounces, this shooting rest is easily portable. Elevate your accuracy and convenience with the Allen Company, trusted for high-quality shooting accessories.
